title: Observation logging hooks under dev/ (kt events, prompts, session copies, /kt-flag)

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/5e2bceba
notes.text: Logging is test-only: scripts in dev/, hooks registered in ~/.claude/settings.json, log in ~/.claude/knowledge-track-log/. Events: kt writes (prompt, command, before/after, project, session, KB commit), kt lookups (exact/fuzzy/miss), kt refusals, SessionEnd summary + transcript copy (transcripts are deleted after 30 days by default), /kt-flag manual notes.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/5e2bceba
notes.text: Baseline from the e2e test (sonnet, one MSM/TICA prompt): rules mostly followed. Misses: tica not linked part-of msm despite the reference example; msm summary names its parts (transition counts), against test 2; the one-step cap kept implied-timescales at 1 although the user justified a lag choice from it (rule says 2), so the cap may be too slow. Watch for these in the logs. Headless runs need --allowedTools Skill or the skill silently fails to load.
